# The clean variant and sevenx_site

This page is for administrators, hosts and website creators who must choose between the 7x site packages, and for
developers who maintain them. It answers: what "clean" changes, and how `sevenx_site` differs from
`sevenx_multisite`.

## Contents

1. [Four packages, two installers](#four-packages-two-installers)
2. [sevenx_multisite_clean](#sevenx_multisite_clean)
3. [sevenx_site and sevenx_site_clean](#sevenx_site-and-sevenx_site_clean)
4. [Side by side](#side-by-side)
5. [Which one to choose](#which-one-to-choose)

## Four packages, two installers

| Package | Summary in its package.xml | Summary in the 6.0.15 index | Installer class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sevenx_multisite` | MultiSite Default Installation | 7x MultiSite Default Installation | `sevenxMultiSiteInstaller` |
| `sevenx_multisite_clean` | MultiSite Default Installation (without demo content) | 7x MultiSite Default Installation (without demo content) | `sevenxMultiSiteInstaller` |
| `sevenx_site` | Website Interface | 7x Simple Website Interface | `SevenxeZWebinInstaller` |
| `sevenx_site_clean` | 7x Simple Website Interface (without demo content) | 7x Simple Website Interface (without demo content) | `SevenxeZWebinInstaller` |

Within each pair the PHP files in `settings/` are identical; only `package.xml` (and for `sevenx_site_clean` the
license text and thumbnail) differs. The index lists all four with `version="6.0-15-stable"`, the same version as their own
`package.xml` (`<number>6.0</number>`, `<release>15-stable</release>`; listed as `1.0.0-0` until 2026-10-19).

## sevenx_multisite_clean

The description in its `package.xml`: "This variant installs the two sites with their structure, configuration,
forms and legal pages, and no demo content." The one functional difference is the content package it requires:

```xml
<require type="ezpackage" name="sevenx_multisite_democontent_clean" min-version="5.1" />
```

Everything else follows from the content that package installs:

- The same siteaccesses, extensions, settings, roles and layouts as `sevenx_multisite`.
- 35 content objects instead of 291 (see [The demo content packages](the-demo-content-packages.md#what-the-clean-package-keeps)).
- Layout references to content that is not installed are removed, rules left without targets are disabled, and
  block links to missing pages are switched off (see [Post-install fixes](post-install-fixes.md)).
- Menu entries for pages that do not exist are left out of `menu.ini`.
- No RSS feed: `setRSSExport()` skips a package whose name ends in `_clean`.

`sevenxDemocontentPackageName()` in `post-install-fix.php` reads the required content package from the site package's
own `package.xml`, so the two variants share every line of code.

## sevenx_site and sevenx_site_clean

`sevenx_site` is the older, single-site package: "the public site in the simple design on the website demo content,
with the administration and editor siteaccesses". Its installer, `settings/sevenxezwebininstaller.php` (5847 lines,
class `SevenxeZWebinInstaller`), is the file `sevenx-multi-site-installer.php` was copied from on 2026-09-07; both
descend from the installer of the `ezwebin_site` package, renamed in January 2024.

| | `sevenx_site` | `sevenx_site_clean` |
|---|---|---|
| Requires | `ezwt_extension`, `ezstarrating_extension`, `ezgmaplocation_extension`, `ezpaypal_extension`, `sevenx_extension`, `sevenx_classes`, `sevenx_banners`, `sevenx_democontent`, `sevenx_design_cleangray`, `sevenx_design_gray`, `sevenx_design_blue` | the same, with `sevenx_democontent_clean` instead of `sevenx_banners` and `sevenx_democontent` |
| Public design | `simple` (`solutionName()`), from `sevenx_themes_simple` | the same |
| Site title when none is typed | "Exponential" | the same |

Compared with `sevenx_multisite`, its installer:

- lists 43 extensions instead of 60: it adds `bcwebshop` and leaves out the `explayouts` family, `expquery_translator`,
  the `expsite_*` extensions, `sevenx_themes_media` and `ezurlmultisite`;
- creates no Bold Agency siteaccesses and no layouts, and seeds no `share/*.dba` of the theme or of `explayouts`;
- has 40 post-install steps instead of 50;
- still installs the admin on `admin4l` (which, without `explayouts`, draws "every page" with admin4's own
  templates), the editor and adminui siteaccesses, two-step sign-in, search statistics and the closed `ezinfo` module.

## Side by side

| | `sevenx_multisite` | `sevenx_multisite_clean` | `sevenx_site` | `sevenx_site_clean` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Public sites | Fit & Healthy, Bold Agency | the same, empty | one | one, empty |
| Public design | `media` | `media` | `simple` | `simple` |
| Page layouts (`explayouts`) | 21 | 21, references pruned | none | none |
| Demo content | 291 objects | 35 objects | `sevenx_democontent` | `sevenx_democontent_clean` |
| Published archive (6.0.15) | 91296 bytes | 91289 bytes | 79291 bytes | 69166 bytes |

The archive sizes are those of the site packages alone, without what they require; `sevenx_multisite_democontent`
alone is 62669990 bytes.

## Which one to choose

| You want to | Choose |
|---|---|
| see what Exponential can do, with layouts and two sites | `sevenx_multisite` |
| build a real site on the multisite structure and layouts | `sevenx_multisite_clean` |
| a single site in the simple design, with demo content | `sevenx_site` |
| a single site in the simple design, to fill yourself | `sevenx_site_clean` |

Install with `exp:install --package=<name>` or `Site_package` in `kickstart.ini`
([6.4 kickstart.ini reference](../../../install/06-kickstarter.md#64-kickstartini-reference)), or pick it on the
setup wizard's site package page. For a host's view of the same choice, see
[Site packages for hosts](../../hosting/provisioning/site-packages.md).

> **Tip**
> None of them fits? Start from the one that is closest and make it your own:
> [Forking a site package](../your-own/forking-a-site-package.md). When it is useful to others, 7x and the Exponential
> Foundation encourage you to submit it: [Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md).
